text.card: A red giant 2,812 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.99 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,936 K at its surface.
